query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' THEN 'has_street'
    ELSE 'no_street'
  END as street_status,
  CASE 
    WHEN zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' THEN 'has_zip'
    ELSE 'no_zip'
  END as zip_status,
  CASE 
    WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 'geocoded'
    ELSE 'not_geocoded'
  END as geo_status,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM pco_people 
WHERE status = 'active'
GROUP BY street_status, zip_status, geo_status
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
